title: Initiative Tether: Mid-Quarter Signal Brief & Rapid Exec Alignment
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Summary:
A compact, repeatable playbook for mid-quarter 'signal' readouts designed to enable fast executive alignment and decisioning without a full QBR. This ticket captures the agenda, pre-read checklist, metric thresholds that trigger escalation, decision asks we plan to bring, and the post-read action flow.

Why this exists:
- Executive time is limited; we need a distilled packet focused on signals, risks, and clear asks.
- Teams are executing multiple initiatives; this template keeps readouts consistent and traceable to OKRs/initiatives.
- Cuts down back-and-forth after readouts by capturing committed follow-ups and owners.

Scope:
- One-pager pre-read and 12-minute live readout format for up to 3 initiatives.
- Tied to OKR metrics and leading indicators from analytics/console dashboards.
- Template for use by PMs to present to Execs, Board Liaisons, and Eng Leads.

Agenda (12 minutes):
1) 2m — One-line status and critical signal (green/amber/red) per initiative.
2) 4m — Key data: one OKR metric, one reliability metric, one cost/throughput metric.
3) 3m — Decision asks and recommended option with impact/effort.
4) 2m — 30/60/90 day risk mitigations and fallback lanes.
5) 1m — Clear next steps and owner commitments.

Pre-read checklist (deliver 48 hours before):
- One-page pre-read PDF in Drive (link below) with charts and callouts.
- GitHub PRs or RFCs for any technical tradeoffs that require approval.
- Data snapshot exported from Console: latency P50/P95, token cost per 1k, error rate, rollout percentage.
- Annotated eval results if the ask impacts quality.

Decision asks (examples we expect to use the template for):
- Increase Dedicated capacity commit by 20% for runtime-1.20 to avoid throttling during product launch. Options: allocate from reserve pool, delay launch, or accept degraded SLOs.
- Approve temporary budget for 2-week cross-team blitz to address KV cache regression.
- Greenlight canary expansion for a new quantized model variant with rollback thresholds.

Trigger thresholds for escalation to full QBR or Board note:
- Customer-impacting incidents >5% of active customers in a week.
- Cost delta >15% vs forecast for an initiative for two consecutive weeks.
- Regression in model-quality metric (per-eval) >7 points against baseline.

Stakeholders to invite:
- VP Product (chair), Head of Engineering, Head of Reliability, Director of Solutions, Finance lead, Solutions Engineer for the initiative, Customer Success rep if a named customer is affected.

Artifacts and links:
- Pre-read Drive template: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-initiative-tether
- One-page template in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PM/Initiative+Tether+Template
- Sample GitHub PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/example-prs (annotated)
- Console dashboard snapshot query: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/initiative-signal-snapshot

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Over-indexing on throughput saves that increase model drift. Mitigation: include quality evals as required artifact when cost/quantization changes are proposed.
- Risk: Execs push for capacity raises without cost context. Mitigation: include short cost-per-1k token chart and estimated monthly delta for each option.

Post-read follow-up flow (within 3 business days):
- PM posts meeting minutes to Confluence and tags owners with due dates.
- Actions tracked as Linear sub-issues linked back to this key (use parent_issue).
- Finance and EngOps produce an impact forecast within 5 business days for any budget asks.

Metrics we surface in packet (minimum):
- OKR primary metric (e.g., feature usage, embeddings units consumed) with trend and target progress.
- Latency P50/P95 (routing cohorts) and change vs baseline.
- Cost per 1000 tokens or per-embedding unit and projected delta by option.
- Error rate and percentage of requests hitting fallback.

Acceptance criteria for using this playbook on a readout:
- Pre-read uploaded 48 hours in advance and verified by Eng Lead.
- Data snapshots are reproducible from Console queries in links.
- Decision options include clear impact, effort, and rollback path.

Open questions / decisions needed now:
- Should Finance pre-approve a small contingency envelope (up to $30k/month) for fast Dedicated capacity spikes? (pro/con in pre-read)
- Do we make the one-page template mandatory for any exec readout with a budget ask?

Next steps:
- Finalize drive + confluence templates and attach sample filled packet by 2026-03-15.
- Run two walk-throughs with PMs in the Roadmap Ops guild the week of 2026-03-16.
- Pilot the playbook in the March mid-month readout for 2 initiatives and collect feedback.

Related issues and dependencies (add linear keys as created):
- parent_issue: PM-300120
- dependencies: ENG-42890, ENG-42901

Notes on communication tone: concise, data-first, clear asks, and explicit fallback thresholds.

Owner notes: Ethan to coordinate the Drive template and run the two walk-through sessions. Maya will draft the finance contingency proposal and collect cost deltas from EngOps.
